item.title: Two People Who Died in Corpach Crash Named By Police
item.description: Two people who died following a crash on the A830 near Corpach have been named by police as David Allan Mackay, 44, and Kai Mathieson, 16, as officers continue enquiries into the circumstances.The post Two People Who Died in Corpach Crash Named By Police appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: More Charities Closed Than Opened in The Highlands Last Year
item.description: More charities closed than opened in the Highlands during 2025, according to new data from the Scottish Charity Register, highlighting the growing financial and operational pressures facing the region’s voluntary sector.The post More Charities Closed Than Opened in The Highlands Last Year appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Post Office Horizon Scandal Victims in Scotland Cleared After Years of Mistreatment
item.description: Dozens of people wrongly convicted in the Post Office Horizon scandal in Scotland have now had their criminal records cleared after years of mistreatment linked to the faulty Horizon computer system.The post Post Office Horizon Scandal Victims in Scotland Cleared After Years of Mistreatment appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: MV Corran Undergoing Sea Trials Today Ahead of Expected Return
item.description: The MV Corran is undergoing final sea trials today after completing its refit, with the vital ferry crossing at Corran Narrows expected to return to normal service during the coming week.The post MV Corran Undergoing Sea Trials Today Ahead of Expected Return appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Council Seeks Local Contractors To Help Maintain Roads
item.description: Orkney Islands Council is inviting farmers and contractors with machinery to join a new framework supporting roads maintenance and winter weather response across the islands.The post Orkney Council Seeks Local Contractors To Help Maintain Roads appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Independence Within Reach as Polls Show Majority Possible
item.description: The SNP says independence is within reach as new polling suggests the party could secure a majority in the Scottish Parliament ahead of the upcoming election campaign.The post Independence Within Reach as Polls Show Majority Possible appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ticket Prices Frozen as Inverness Caley Thistle Face Raith Rovers in Trophy Final
item.description: Ticket prices have been frozen for the 2025 to 2026 KDM Evolution Trophy final as Inverness Caledonian Thistle face Raith Rovers at the Wyre Stadium at Firhill on 5 April.The post Ticket Prices Frozen as Inverness Caley Thistle Face Raith Rovers in Trophy Final appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Rare Harris Croft With House Plot and Sea Views
item.description: A 15.2 acre croft tenancy at Borsham near Finsbay in the Bays of Harris, including a de crofted house plot with planning permission for a five bedroom home overlooking Loch Finsbay.The post A Rare Harris Croft With House Plot and Sea Views appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Energy Tax Row as Douglas Alexander Accused of Betraying Scottish Workers
item.description: Douglas Alexander faces criticism after the Energy Profits Levy remained in place, with warnings the policy risks harming Scotland’s offshore energy sector and threatening jobs tied to North Sea investment.The post Energy Tax Row as Douglas Alexander Accused of Betraying Scottish Workers appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: BBC Debate Night Heads To Ullapool and Audience Applications are Open
item.description: BBC Scotland’s Debate Night is heading to Ullapool on Wednesday 18 March and people from across the Highlands are being invited to apply for free audience tickets and take part in the national political discussion.The post BBC Debate Night Heads To Ullapool and Audience Applications are Open appeared first on The Highland Times.
